experiments.scope: The exact blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target. One trial of proof.md Section 4 per organizer seed: the context words C0.c1, C0.d1, S15, S9, w5, X2 and a member number of the sub-class S8 are taken from SHAKE-256 of the seed, and D3.d1 = X3 as in the algorithm (so X14 = 0), and the 55-byte and 63-byte messages are built by steps O, M, Y, T, S2, S3 with the quarter-round G only. Every trial returns its pair. The program locates the batch of the order S2K14 that holds the trial (C2.a1 = X2 + X6 + w7 = (7g + l) 2^14 + i) and runs the counted pieces for the pair of positions i AND NOT 1, i OR 1 that holds it: the outer step from a 256-bit word whose words 0 to 2 are the three coin words, the member step, the end of group g - 1 (g > 0) and the set-up of group g, the block update, the X2-table entry and the table words of both positions, the counted pair (Section 5: stage A of both batches, the pair test, the hit tests and stages B and C of both batches, computed whatever the decisions, with the spill; the accumulator changes only as in the staged flow), the same pair again in the staged flow on a copy of the machine (decisions, budget counts and per-part operation counts compared with the forced run and with the ledger's per-entry charges) and the block test. It compares every word the pieces leave with the construction; for each of the 14 lanes of the two batches (seven values of X2) it compares bit 32 of the stage-A flag with rule A on h1 and bit 32 of the stage-B flag with rule A and the beta filter on c1 of E1, both from the program's own 2-round compression of that lane's messages, and the four packed residual words (Lemma D') and the zero indicator with the digests of the same compression; it compares the pair decision and both stage decisions of each batch with 'some lane taking part passes'. It returns the counts as observations.
experiments.hypothesis: Every returned pair agrees on digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7 (Theorem 1; exact). Predicted observations for every seed: stage_a_ops 18, stage_b_ops 66, stage_c_ops 119, hit_spill_ops 12 (hit tests 6 and spill 6 per forced pair), block_test_ops 4, outer_ops 274, table_word_ops 94, member_ops 118, block_ops 4, group_ops_right 1, pieces_right 1, lanes_right 14, flags_right 14, decisions_right 2, tests_right 1, member_in_s8 1. Observations are the program's own and are not a verified cost; this does not test H1.

experiments.scope: The exact target. Per organizer seed one outer step and member (D3.d1 = X3 as in the algorithm), a group g < 37,449 and ten consecutive positions 256 b + 252 .. 256 b + 261 (b < 63; five pairs), so that two block updates run, all from SHAKE-256 of the seed: the ten packed batches of the order S2K14 in five counted pairs (70 trials, seven values of X2 per position, C2.a1 = (7g + l) 2^14 + i) run in the staged flow with the block test, after the counted outer step, member step, group end and set-up and table words of each position; every trial is computed forwards from its messages. The pair of lane 0 of the first batch is returned. Observations check Y4 of both messages, eta, the words the pieces leave, the stage flags, the pair decisions and the stage decisions (each pair also run in the staged flow on a copy of the machine and compared), the four packed residual words (Lemma D': D1, D3, ROL(D4,7) ^ D1, D6 of A XOR B) and the zero indicator of every lane, the block test, the group operation counts and Lemma B, and count the lanes that satisfy rule A, the beta filter, and both, and the batches that enter stage B and stage C.
experiments.hypothesis: Every returned pair agrees on the 128 masked bits (exact). Predicted for every seed: trials 70, y4_equal 70, eta_equal 70, lanes_right 70, flags_right 70, decisions_right 10, tests_right 1, pieces_right 1, group_ops_right 1, block_updates 2, lemma_b 6. rule_a_lanes, filter_lanes and filter_and_rule_a_lanes have means near 70 * 2^-5, 70 * 2^-6 and 70 * 2^-11 per seed under the model M (expected totals 560, 280 and 8.75 over 256 seeds); stage_b_batches and stage_c_batches are at most rule_a_lanes and filter_and_rule_a_lanes for every seed (one entry needs one passing lane), with M values 10 * (1 - (31/32)^7) and about 10 * 7 * 2^-11 per seed (totals 510.2 and 8.75). Rule A clusters, so totals vary from run to run and no per-run range is predicted. H1 (ii) bounds run averages: the stage-B ratio of one run (stage_b_batches / 510.2) has expectation about 0.377 (the run average measured in proof.md Section 8.2) and a large run-to-run spread, because each seed is one outer step and member and ten consecutive positions, so its batches are clustered; one run is not evidence for or against H1 (ii). Participant-run local replays of the shipped program (public seed and 40 nonces of our own, preregistered and all reported) are listed in proof.md Section 6. Nothing here is evidence for F or H1 (ii), which proof.md Section 8.2 estimates from a preregistered uniform sample of 2^35 batches of this order (0.37659 p_B, premise 0.377 p_B; 1.00006 * 2^-11, premise 1.003 * 2^-11).
